targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  src_endpoint.ip as source_ip,
  dst_endpoint.ip as destination_ip,
  'Large Data Transfer' as exfiltration_type,
  toInt64(sum(traffic.bytes_out)) as total_bytes_sent,
  count(*) as connection_count,
  'Network' as source_table
FROM network_activity
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND dst_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND traffic.bytes_out > 1000000
GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip
HAVING sum(traffic.bytes_out) > 5000000
UNION ALL
SELECT
  src_endpoint.ip as source_ip,
  dst_endpoint.ip as destination_ip,
  'File Upload Activity' as exfiltration_type,
  toInt64(count(*) * 1000000) as total_bytes_sent,
  count(*) as connection_count,
  'SMB' as source_table
FROM smb_activity
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND dst_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND activity_name = 'File Open'
GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip
HAVING count(*) > 10
UNION ALL
SELECT
  src_endpoint.ip as source_ip,
  dst_endpoint.ip as destination_ip,
  'HTTP File Transfer' as exfiltration_type,
  toInt64(count(*) * 500000) as total_bytes_sent,
  count(*) as connection_count,
  'HTTP' as source_table
FROM http_activity
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND dst_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND activity_name IN ('POST', 'PUT')
GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip
HAVING count(*) > 5
ORDER BY total_bytes_sent DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT time, metric, bytes
FROM (
  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(time) as time,
    'Large Outbound Traffic' as metric,
    toInt64(sum(traffic.bytes_out)) as bytes
  FROM network_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND traffic.bytes_out > 1000000
  GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(time) as time,
    'File Operations' as metric,
    toInt64(count(*) * 1000000) as bytes
  FROM smb_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND activity_name = 'File Open'
  GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(time) as time,
    'HTTP Uploads' as metric,
    toInt64(count(*) * 500000) as bytes
  FROM http_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND activity_name IN ('POST', 'PUT')
  GROUP BY time
)
ORDER BY time ASC, metric ASC

SELECT
  dst_endpoint.ip as external_ip,
  'Suspicious External Connections' as pattern_type,
  count(DISTINCT src_endpoint.ip) as internal_hosts,
  count(*) as total_connections,
  groupArray(DISTINCT src_endpoint.ip) as internal_ips
FROM network_activity
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND dst_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND toString(dst_endpoint.ip) NOT LIKE '10.%'
  AND toString(dst_endpoint.ip) NOT LIKE '192.168.%'
  AND toString(dst_endpoint.ip) NOT LIKE '172.%'
GROUP BY dst_endpoint.ip
HAVING count(DISTINCT src_endpoint.ip) > 2
ORDER BY total_connections DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  'Large Network Transfers' as risk_category,
  count(*) as connection_count,
  'Network Activity' as detection_method,
  '>5MB total outbound' as threshold
FROM (
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip
  FROM network_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND traffic.bytes_out > 1000000
  GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip
  HAVING sum(traffic.bytes_out) > 5000000
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'File Access Patterns' as risk_category,
  count(*) as connection_count,
  'SMB Activity' as detection_method,
  '>10 file operations' as threshold
FROM (
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip
  FROM smb_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND activity_name = 'File Open'
  GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip
  HAVING count(*) > 10
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'HTTP Upload Activity' as risk_category,
  count(*) as connection_count,
  'HTTP Activity' as detection_method,
  '>5 POST/PUT requests' as threshold
FROM (
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip
  FROM http_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND activity_name IN ('POST', 'PUT')
  GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip
  HAVING count(*) > 5
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'External Connections' as risk_category,
  count(*) as connection_count,
  'Network Activity' as detection_method,
  '>2 internal hosts to same external IP' as threshold
FROM (
  SELECT dst_endpoint.ip
  FROM network_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND toString(dst_endpoint.ip) NOT LIKE '10.%'
    AND toString(dst_endpoint.ip) NOT LIKE '192.168.%'
    AND toString(dst_endpoint.ip) NOT LIKE '172.%'
  GROUP BY dst_endpoint.ip
  HAVING count(DISTINCT src_endpoint.ip) > 2
)
ORDER BY connection_count DESC

SELECT
  src_endpoint.ip as source_ip,
  'Multi-Protocol Data Transfer' as exfiltration_pattern,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_table = 'Network' THEN 'Network' END) as network_events,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_table = 'SMB' THEN 'SMB' END) as smb_events,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_table = 'HTTP' THEN 'HTTP' END) as http_events,
  toInt64(sum(CASE WHEN source_table = 'Network' THEN traffic_bytes ELSE 0 END)) as total_bytes,
  time
FROM (
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip, 'Network' as source_table, traffic.bytes_out as traffic_bytes, time FROM network_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND traffic.bytes_out > 1000000
  UNION ALL
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip, 'SMB' as source_table, 1000000 as traffic_bytes, time FROM smb_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND activity_name = 'File Open'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip, 'HTTP' as source_table, 500000 as traffic_bytes, time FROM http_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND activity_name IN ('POST', 'PUT')
) exfiltration_data
WHERE src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip, time
HAVING (network_events > 0 AND smb_events > 0) OR (network_events > 0 AND http_events > 0) OR (smb_events > 0 AND http_events > 0)
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC, time DESC
LIMIT 15
